title.narrative: Förberedande stöd Centre for Policies and Reform
Preparatory support Centre for Policies and Reform

description.narrative: The expected final objective is to strengthen the organization by developing and implementing several important policies for good governance within the CPR team so that the organization can develop sustainably over a long period of time. CPR aims to work with staff and Management Board members to develop, approve and implement policies and documents necessary for the smooth running of the organization.

Det förberedande kärnstödet för CPR bereds som en förenklad insats. Syftet med det förberedande kärnstödet är att stärka organisationens kapacitet och utveckla deras interna regelverk.
CPR kommer under denna första fas av stödet att genomföra prioriterade rekommendationer från Swedish Development Advisors från system based audit rapporten framtagen 2020. Därför kommer CPR att utveckla institutionell kapacitet, interna rutiner, personalkunskaper och andra färdigheter för att kunna genomföra kärnstödsaktiviteter. Baserat på en kommande uppföljningsrapport som avser aktiviteter under denna första fas (rapport tas preliminärt fram i december 2021) kan Sida sedan överväga att fortsätta med kärnstöd till CPR baserat på en strategisk plan, resultatram och den strategiska budgeten som utvecklats inför kärnstödet.
Insatsens totala budget uppgår till 343 380 SEK.

The pre-core support granted for CPR is a simplified contribution which aims at supporting the organization to develop its internal capacities and policies.
During preparatory support phase CPR will implement priority recommendations provided by the Swedish Development Advisors in the system-based audit report produced in 2020. Therefore, it will develop institutional capacities, internal routines, staff knowledge and skills to be able to implement core-support activities. Based on a follow-up report on pre-core activities to be conducted tentatively in December 2021, Sida may consider continuing with core-support with CPR based on the Strategic Plan, RAF and strategic budget developed during pre-core support.
The interventions' total budget is 343 380 SEK.

It is assessed that the organization generally reached the set objectives. CPR implemented the recommendations of the SBA, from more technical ones - like the requirement of two signatures for payments - to policies (financial management, procurement and anti-corruption policies), which were consulted with and adopted by the board.
During the preparatory support period the Centre has worked focusing on the implementation of the 26 recommendations that were categorized as highest priority in the SBA. CPR worked closely with the consultant from the Swedish Development Advisors, sharing all the documents, having rounds of comments and online calls, when needed. Each of the CPR staff member was responsible or part of a working group as reflected in the initial proposal. All of the developed documents were shared with the SDA for a final evaluation, followed by comments.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
